newsitem.title: USA: PLC Systems seeks partner, CEO to resign.
newsitem.headline: PLC Systems seeks partner, CEO to resign.

text.p: PLC Systems Inc said Tuesday that its board had hired Goldman Sachs and Co as the company's financial advisor in seeking a strategic alliance partner.
The company said its board also accepted the resignation of President and Chief Executive Officer, M. Lee Hibbs, effective July 3l.

PLC Systems is developing alternative treatments for coronary artery disease. Its subsidiary, PLC Medical Systems Inc, has a new cardiosurgical procedure known as Transmyocardial Revascularization, which has been granted expedited review of its PreMarket Approval application.
The company said full approval from the Food and Drug Administration could come in the summer.

"There is a great deal of excitement for TMR in the medical community with an estimated market potential of more than $1 billion. Goldman Sachs is helping the company to identify strategic partners who would assist PLC Systems in reaching the broadest audience, both domestically and abroad, for its products," the company said.
It said is working with a national search firm to find a successor for Hibbs who can lead PLC in its transition from a development company to a manufacturing and sales organization.
